values.en: A constant is a globally named closed expression. A global signature records its name, definition body, and whether that body is transparent. Unlike a free variable, a constant does not require a local free-variable assignment.
values.zh-CN: 常量是在全局语境中具名的闭表达式。全局签名记录其名称、定义体以及该定义体是否透明。常量不同于自由变量，不需要局部的自由变量赋值。
